title: Queen: finish the net
tip: Keep the queen protected and remove every escape square.

title: Rook: the last rank
tip: Your king covers the seventh rank. Use the rook on the eighth.

title: Queen and king
tip: Shrink the king’s box, then bring your king closer. Watch for stalemate.

title: Cut off the king
tip: Keep the rook cutting off a rank while your king approaches.

title: Two bishops
tip: Use both diagonals to push the king toward an edge.

title: Bishop and knight
tip: Drive the king toward a corner matching your bishop’s color.

title: The final pawn step
tip: Promote on the eighth rank. You may choose any promotion piece.

title: King in front
tip: Use your king and spare pawn tempi to make progress.

title: The outside passer
tip: Count how many king steps the opponent needs to catch your pawn.

title: Connected passers
tip: Keep the pawns protecting each other instead of advancing blindly.

title: The pawn race
tip: Calculate which pawn reaches its promotion square first.

title: Build a bridge
tip: Use your rook as shelter against checks before moving the king.

title: Third-rank defense
tip: Keep the attacking king away, then switch to checks from behind.

title: Bishop stops the pawn
tip: Capture the last pawn to reach insufficient mating material.

title: Knight stops the pawn
tip: Find the knight capture that removes the last pawn.

title: Bishop and rook pawn
tip: Find a safe way to remove the last pawn.

title: Queen against rook
tip: Coordinate king and queen; watch for forks and rook stalemate tricks.
